name: Laurence
long_description:
Advertising today is like trading in the 1980s pits: archaic, manual, and iterative guesswork. Humans update bids and keywords with noisy, delayed data using simple if-else rules that both break at scale and ignore stochasticity.

Laurence advertises like modern hedge funds trade markets, driving a 15-40% improvement in net profit for Amazon brands within a month of onboarding.

launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋

We’re [Matt](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1795983) and [Leo](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/3241658) building [Laurence](https://www.trylaurence.com/): automated Amazon pay-per-click (PPC) performance marketing using reinforcement learning and transformer models.

<https://youtu.be/EAiSUSByF6k>

**TL;DR**

* **Most brands lose money** advertising on Amazon after margin
  * Agencies outsource **simplistic copy-paste playbooks** to offshore workers
  * Existing software are rudimentary rules engines that break with any bad variance
* We drive performance using **reinforcement learning** and training our own conversion-rate-aware transformer models
* Our quant system is automating **$10 million in live ad spend**, increasing advertising profits by 15-20% while growing total revenue.

**Team**

Matt

* built the Data Science Agent at Google
* tuned the Facebook friend suggestion model at Meta
* was the third engineer at a health-tech startup

Leo

* made $250k as a high-stakes poker pro at 17
* founded a crypto investing startup at 18
* was a researcher at Jump Trading

We started off building a horizontal data science agent for enterprise, and from our hundreds of conversations with anyone who had a problem with data, we learned how desperately brands on Amazon needed PPC automation that works.

**Ask**

If you know any CPG brands or SMBs selling on Amazon, we would love an introduction :)
